entries.title: Early progression
summary: Prepare tools, cooked food, and bronze equipment in Starter Town before exploring Main Overworld.

steps.title: Gather basic tools
body: Keep a Knife for Fletching, a Tinderbox for Firemaking, and a Hammer for Smithing. Use Talk-to on Starter Town NPCs to find suppliers and learn which merchants require quests.

steps.title: Make gathering equipment
body: Fletching makes handles from logs, Crafting straps them with leather, and Smithing makes metal heads and blades. Combine matching parts through Crafting to finish an axe, pickaxe, or sword.

steps.title: Prepare food and choose a goal
body: Catch shrimp with a Small Net and cook them on a fire. Mine copper and tin for Bronze Bars if you need more equipment.
With tools and food ready, follow the bronze gear, fishing, or first runes journey. Bring suitable equipment before hunting boars and wolves for Tanner Rusk.

entries.title: Hides Of The Frontier
summary: Tanner Rusk needs 4 boar tusks and 2 wolf fangs for Hides of the Frontier in Main Overworld.
Completing this quest awards 200 coins and 125 Crafting XP and opens his tannery merchant access. Bring suitable equipment and cooked food before hunting.
entries.audience: players prepared for boars and wolves

steps.title: Talk to Tanner Rusk
body: Talk to Tanner Rusk at the tannery in the Starter Town area of Main Overworld to begin Hides of the Frontier.
Check the quest log and prepare a weapon and cooked food before heading for boars and wolves.

steps.title: Collect tusks and fangs
body: Hunt boars and wolves in Main Overworld and take their ground drops. Collect 4 boar tusks and 2 wolf fangs.
Raw boar and wolf meat also have Cooking recipes, but these meats do not replace the tusks and fangs required for the quest.

steps.title: Turn in the materials
body: Return to Tanner Rusk with all 4 boar tusks and 2 wolf fangs and use his quest dialogue to turn them in. The requested materials are consumed.
You receive 200 coins and 125 Crafting XP, and his leather merchant becomes available for later Crafting recipes.

entries.title: Bronze gear
summary: Smelt copper and tin into Bronze Bars, forge metal parts, and assemble your first tools and weapon. Armor and shields use their own anvil recipes.

steps.title: Smelt Bronze Bars
body: Mine copper and tin, then take them to a furnace in Starter Town. Each Bronze Bar uses one Copper Ore and one Tin Ore.

steps.title: Assemble tools and a sword
body: Take Bronze Bars and a Hammer to an anvil to forge heads or a sword blade. These parts cannot be equipped on their own.
Make a Wooden Handle through Fletching, strap it with Normal Leather through Crafting, then combine it with the matching bronze head or blade. Check each recipe's level and quantities.

steps.title: Forge armor and a shield
body: At Smithing level 1, use the anvil recipes for a Bronze Shield, Helmet, Platebody, Platelegs, or Boots. Their bar costs differ: boots use 2, a helmet 5, a shield 6, platelegs 7, and a platebody 9. Choose a piece before gathering more ore.

entries.title: Fishing to food
summary: Catch fish and cook them into healing food. Fishing and Cooking have separate levels, so check both requirements before moving to a new catch.

steps.title: Buy fishing tools
body: Visit the Fishing Supplier in Starter Town. A Small Net catches shrimp at Fishing level 1; a Fishing Rod with Bait catches trout at 10 and salmon at 20.

steps.title: Cook your catch
body: Use raw fish on a fire. Shrimp requires Cooking level 1 and trout level 10. A burnt result does not heal; cooked shrimp restores 3 Hitpoints and cooked trout restores 5.

steps.title: Prepare stronger food
body: Cooked salmon restores 7 Hitpoints, tuna 9, and swordfish 12. Tuna requires Fishing and Cooking level 30; swordfish requires 40. Use a Harpoon for these catches and check which water supports the method.

entries.title: First runes
summary: Gather Rune essence and craft runes at the elemental altars in Main Overworld. Start with ember runes, then use higher-level altars as your Runecrafting increases.

steps.title: Mine Rune essence
body: Carry a pickaxe to the Rune Essence Mine in Main Overworld. Mining essence starts at level 1, and every rune recipe uses it.

steps.title: Craft elemental runes
body: Start with ember runes at level 1, then water at 10, earth at 20, and air at 30.
The altar must match the recipe. Combination runes require level 40, the combination unlock, essence, and a secondary rune.

steps.title: Use pouches and combination recipes
body: Pouches carry extra essence subject to their level and capacity requirements. Check the Runecrafting tables before buying one.
Combination runes require Runecrafting level 40, the combination unlock, essence, and a secondary rune. The altar must match the recipe.
